messages:
jamal: Heads-up — planned reliability window this Saturday 2023-04-22 02:00-04:00 UTC for west-1 control plane maintenance. We're also turning on the new "reliability guardrails" policy Monday (internal SLO burn thresholds + automated short-term capacity addon). Details below.

infra-schedule-bot: maintenance created: maintenance-3478 · control-plane-west-1 · 2023-04-22T02:00Z-04:00Z · owner=jamal · runbook=https://runbooks.internal/reliability/guardrails

oncall-bot: Paging oncall: monitor p99 latency, 5xx rate, and token errors during the window. Alert if p99 > 300ms for 5m. Runbook excerpt pinned in thread.

maria: Quick q — what's the rollback path if automated failover misbehaves? @jamal

jamal: Rollback plan summary: 1) cancel capacity addon, 2) re-route traffic to previous route-set, 3) scale up control-plane replicas to previous count. Full steps in runbook (link above).

alex: Does this change any customer-facing SLAs? Do we need to notify customers?

jamal: No SLA changes. This is an internal guardrail to reduce manual ops during bursts. We'll send an internal-facing note to account/sales for heads-up; public-facing SLA remains unchanged.

rachel: Dedicated pools — will they be auto-scaled by the addon?

jamal: Dedicated pools are opted out by default. The addon only touches shared pools unless an opt-in label is present. Ops will coordinate any opt-ins.

li: Can we run a dry-run for the rehearsal? I'd like to exercise KV cache warmup and the prefix prefetch.

jamal: Yes — rehearsal will include a dry-run traffic shift (10% real traffic, 10% synthetic, 80% baseline) and a KV warmup pass. Expect some trace noise but no customer impact target.

emma: :thumbsup: I'll take traces and dashboard screenshots during the run.

infra-schedule-bot: maintenance-3478 · tasks:
- cordon & drain control-plane nodes
- run KV prefix warmup job (warmup-job-23)
- enable capacity-addon in monitor mode (no auto-scale for dry-run)

oncall-bot: Recommended checklists: monitor p99, request success ratio, token error rate, redis miss rate. Runbook snippet:

```
# drain control plane nodes
kubectl cordon nodepool-west-1-control-*
kubectl drain nodepool-west-1-control-* --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# kick off warmup job
kubectl apply -f warmup-job-23.yaml
```

jamal: Also note: we're instituting a short blackout window for large batch jobs going forward — 02:00-06:00 UTC nightly for the west-1 control plane maintenance window. CI/CD heavy jobs should be re-scheduled. I'll add guidance to the infra docs.

alex: I'll update the data pipelines and add a pre-check to reject runs that overlap blackout window.

maria: If anything exceeds 10% SLO burn during the rehearsal, we do a postmortem. Template will be posted to #postmortems.

jamal: Correct. Postmortem threshold: >10% SLO burn OR >5m sustained p99 increase. I'll DM anyone who wants to be on the rehearsal call. If you can't make it, please leave runbook review comments by EOD Friday.

oncall-bot: rehearsal call scheduled: 2023-04-22T01:45Z · zoom://call/rehearsal-3478 · calendar invite sent to participants.

jamal: Thanks all — please review the runbook link and flag any outstanding risks. I'll post the checklist update and a short preflight tomorrow morning.
